sources.title: Best THRILLustrious Models | PromptHero
sources.snippet: The challenge is to continuously add realism aspects without sacrificing the base flexibility and concepts of the base model. This is a bit more difficult with Illustrious because many of the concepts baked into the base model are artistic/anime at their core.

sources.title: THRILLustrious - AI Art Model | PixAI
sources.snippet: Generate stunning realistic, checkpoint, base_model, illustriousxl anime art with the 'THRILLustrious' model on PixAI. Browse artworks made with this model and try it free.

sources.title: Illustrious XL Model Archive - Evolution of AI Models
sources.snippet: Explore Illustrious XL's AI model archive, tracking its evolution from v0.1 to the latest innovations. See how each version advances AI image generation.

sources.title: Five Stars Illustrious 8.0 - AIxFun eStudio's Ko-fi Shop
sources.snippet: Where earlier versions smoothed and polished, Five Stars Illustrious 8.0 sharpens and enriches, offering creators imagery that feels more alive, more dimensional, and more commanding in presence. 📌 To download the model, you will be prompted to link your Hugging Face email to your Ko-fi email if they are different.
